Hi Jane,

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation, attached is Proposal_v3.pdf and a proposed MAP_timeline.xlsx that ties pricing and ramp credits to three checkpoints during your 90-day evaluation. High level: 1) POC kickoff (Week 0) — 0% commit, evaluation credits applied; 2) Checkpoint A (Week 4) — 20% minimum committed capacity to qualify for 10% ramp credit; 3) Checkpoint B (Week 8) — 50% commit to unlock additional volume discount; 4) Final commit (Week 12) — full negotiated reserved rate.

Ask: Can you confirm the checkpoint dates and whether your team will accept the proposed evaluation metrics (latency < 250ms p95 on 8k tokens, pass security questionnaire answers for data handling)? If you approve, we'll prepare a HubSpot deal update and a DocuSign envelope for a MAP Intent signature (non-binding acceptance of checkpoint dates).

Att: Proposal_v3.pdf, MAP_timeline.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m call if you want to walk through the schedule.

Regards,

The checkpoint commitments are aggregate across your account (we can break down by region if you prefer). We can accommodate a 30-day extension to the POC, but that will shift Checkpoint B out by 30 days unless you want to keep internal milestone dates and add a separate evaluation checkpoint — which we can do.

Jane / team —

Attached is pricing_schedule_v4.xlsx that lays out both options. Summary of the commercial iterations:

- Option A (Invoice credit): 10% one-time invoice credit at Checkpoint A (20% aggregate commit), additional 7% invoice credit at Checkpoint B (50% commit). Credit issued after verification of metric pass and usage reports.
- Option B (Rate-card): 7% off effective hourly rate at Checkpoint A; 12% off at Checkpoint B; final reserved rate at full commit negotiated below.

Additional notes: any invoice-credit >10% requires director-level approval (Marissa sign-off), credits are applied within 60 days of checkpoint verification. For the requested 30-day POC extension we propose adding an interim evaluation checkpoint at Day 60 (one-time success gate) — if Nimbus passes, we will apply a one-time 5% extension credit and shift the remaining checkpoints accordingly.

Please confirm by Nov 17 if you want the POC extended and which commercial option you prefer so we can route for approvals.
